issues.explanation: Daily archive retention is not wired to LOG_DAILY_DAYS in config/logging.php; the diff adds the env key to .env.example but never reads it, so changing the env value would have no effect.
issues.location: config/logging.php:daily channel (no LOG_DAILY_DAYS; cf. audit at config/logging.php:247-248)

issues.explanation: Context formatting happens outside the soft-fail try block, so a throwing value (throwing __toString or jsonSerialize) would escape send instead of being caught and logged.
Audit channel reads LOG_AUDIT_DAYS/LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL as raw env strings without casting days to int, unlike typical Laravel integer handling for retention days.

review.summary: The change implements the DiscordOpsAlert notifier with redaction, truncation and soft-fail plus the audit/daily/stack logging lanes with tests and docs. It needs changes before merging because the daily channel is not wired to LOG_DAILY_DAYS and context formatting sits outside the never-throw guard.
